estimate: ~200 hours to platinum (PowerPyx); PushSquare estimates up to 300
missableNote: PowerPyx lists exactly 1 potentially missable trophy: Positive Mental Attitude, whose first meditation in Chapter 1 can be lost. Everything else is doable after the story in free-roam. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (10 saves of the 15 slots) as insurance.

stages.detail: Play the 5 chapters (60–80 h). All 12 story trophies pop on their own. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude BEFORE Chapter 1 ends — talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning after Down to Earth, follow her to the balcony, choose Accept. Pick up optional missions as they appear (purple icons, black icons with pink letters) and scan vehicles and animals as you go: 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals count toward 100%.
stages.name: 1 · Story first

stages.detail: After the ending, Progress > Stats > 100% Completion opens. It is closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, any 200 vehicles scanned, any 100 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges — but ALL robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret quests. This is where the two golds and most silvers land.
stages.name: 2 · The 100% checklist

stages.detail: The Strangers & Freaks strands and the character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) are not needed for 100%, so they are usually what is left. All of them stay available after the story. Finish 8 stranger strands for the silver, then each character's final mission.
stages.name: 3 · Strangers & character quests

stages.detail: Money and the odd ones out: launder $250,000 in marked bills, spend $100,000 in shops, buy all 8 garages, register 10 vehicles. Five trophies have no verified method yet (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) — this guide flags them honestly instead of inventing steps; check PowerPyx for updates.
stages.name: 4 · Money, properties & the unknowns

stages.detail: When the other 54 are earned, Vice Got a Price! pops. No online play, no DLC, one playthrough.
stages.name: 5 · Platinum
